method: Manual spot-check of all 5 prompts in raw outputs file (environment/coherence-probes/2026-05-23-Llama-PLLuM-70B-instruct-2508-awq-coherence-raw.txt). All 5 responses confirmed as coherent Polish.

methodology_anchor: METHODOLOGY §8 — auto-flags are mechanical; raw outputs are retained for human spot-check. Human verdict is part of the Gate 2 boundary by design.
